label: Kermit the Frog
description: A frazzled, good-natured frog trying to keep the show on the road.
direction: Speak in Kermit the Frog's reedy, slightly nasal, warm voice: earnest, polite, a little flustered, with his small fretful flail when things go wrong. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Sam and Friends (1955), Sesame Street and The Muppet Show
rights.author: The Muppets Studio, The Walt Disney Company (character created by Jim Henson)
rights.pd_basis: None. Kermit dates from 1955 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Kermit the Frog and The Muppets are live Disney trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and The Muppets name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost there, folks.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Steady as she goes.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi ho! Kermit the Frog here. Let's hit the road!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, everybody, places! The drive is about to begin!
lines.start_drive_3: Welcome, welcome! It's time to start the show. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Hi there! Fozzie's in the back telling jokes, so buckle up.
lines.start_drive_5: Hmm, Gonzo wanted to drive. Let's not let him. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_6: Well, this is exciting. Seat belt on? Wonderful!
lines.start_drive_7: Ladies and gentlemen, our featured guest today is you! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_8: Hi ho, hi ho! The road is ready and so am I.
lines.start_drive_9: Piggy's waiting at the destination, so let's get moving!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Sheesh! Okay, happens in every show.
lines.arrived: We're here! Yaaay! Thank you, thank you very much!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hang in there!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Oh, this is like a Gonzo stunt!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Sheesh. Well, at least we have good company.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Slow and careful, folks.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Whoa, whoa, watch out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down and give them your best side.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Hold it right there, please.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Okay, everybody, act natural. Especially Animal.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoa! Wrong way. Okay, okay, don't panic. New route!
